requirements.name: full_name
requirements.prompt: What is the applicant's full legal name, exactly as it appears in their passport?

requirements.name: date_of_birth
requirements.prompt: What is their date of birth? Please give it as YYYY-MM-DD.

requirements.name: nationality
requirements.prompt: What is their nationality (as shown on their passport)?

requirements.name: cas_reference
requirements.prompt: What is the Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) reference number given by your course provider?

requirements.name: course_provider
requirements.prompt: What is the name of the licensed student sponsor (your course provider)?

requirements.name: course_start_date
requirements.prompt: When does the course start? Please give it as YYYY-MM-DD.

requirements.name: funds_available_gbp
requirements.prompt: Roughly how much money (in GBP) do you have available to cover course fees and living costs?

requirements.name: passport_bio_page
requirements.prompt: Do you have a clear copy of the passport bio-data page ready? Please confirm.

requirements.name: cas_letter
requirements.prompt: Do you have your CAS confirmation letter from your course provider ready? Please confirm.

requirements.name: financial_evidence
requirements.prompt: Do you have financial evidence ready (bank statements, loan letter, or sponsorship confirmation)? Please confirm.
